newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 12.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 12.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Hungarian Prime Minister Gyula Horn said he believed four or five parties can reach the necessary level to get into parliament following next year's elections.
- Hungary's Christian Democrats refused to establish a joint fraction with the Hungarian Democratic Forum.
- Hungary's finance ministry expects 40 billion to 80 billion forints to be available in pension funds after the approval of the pension law.
- Hungary's customs office do not expect a traffic jam at the bordiers in the summer in connection with the usual rush of guest workers, due to the introduced new measures.
